name: Centre College
academic_ranking: Highly regarded national liberal arts college. U.S. News & World Report 2025 ranked Centre tied for No. 59 among national liberal arts colleges, No. 19 for Best Value, and tied for No. 22 for Study Abroad. Four-year graduation rate exceeds 80% (reportedly the highest of any Kentucky college or university).
financial_aid: Centre College offers need-based and merit-based aid. A verified current tuition/aid dollar figure could not be confirmed from an authoritative live source during research (2026-07); official figures should be confirmed at centre.edu/admission-aid. Endowment reported at $414.3M (2025).
facilities_notes: Softball is played at Centre's on-campus softball facility. Specific facility details were not confirmed from a live public source during research (2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Southern Athletic Association (SAA) as the Centre Colonels. Team social account: @CentreCSoftball.
notes: As an NCAA Division III institution, Centre College does not award athletic scholarships (scholarship_count = null); aid is need- and merit-based only. Undergraduate enrollment ~1,356 (fall 2023). Located in Danville, KY. Coaching staff and roster verified via centrecolonels.com (2026-07). Tuition left null because no authoritative live figure could be confirmed (do-not-guess rule).
